exposure: Severe brain injury (SBI; severe IVH or cystic PVL)
cohort: The study included preterm infants born at less than 29 weeks gestation or with a birth weight under 1000g, who attended an Early Neurodevelopment Clinic at 3 to 4 months corrected age.
finding: Preterm infants with severe intraventricular haemorrhage (IVH) and severe brain injury (SBI) had a significantly increased risk of early cerebral palsy/high-risk cerebral palsy diagnosis at 3 to 4 months corrected age.
